statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2026-0543 is an informational unmaintained-crate notice for chrono, not a vulnerability: there is no vulnerable code to be present. Recorded per the L2 contract (known, decided, written down); the migration away is ordinary maintenance, not a security action. chrono@0.4.45 reaches iiif-server only through object_store@0.14.2. The decision is a fact about chrono@0.4.45, so the product names the dependency: every release whose SBOM ships this exact package@version is covered by derivation, and a release that moves to another version is deliberately NOT covered — a changed version is a fresh judgment. Blast-radius query behind this decision: audit:blast-radius, canon audit run 44211194942, 2026-11-18.
